title: Writing systems of the world
intro: Name the script most commonly used to write each language.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Marshallese?
questions.explain: Marshallese is most commonly written in the Latin script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Armenian?
questions.explain: Armenian is most commonly written in the Armenian script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write North Ndebele?
questions.explain: North Ndebele is most commonly written in the Latin script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Hindi?
questions.explain: Hindi is most commonly written in the Devanagari script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Ngazidja Comorian?
questions.explain: Ngazidja Comorian is most commonly written in the Arabic script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Czech?
questions.explain: Czech is most commonly written in the Latin script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Russian?
questions.explain: Russian is most commonly written in the Cyrillic script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Belarusian?
questions.explain: Belarusian is most commonly written in the Cyrillic script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Ukrainian?
questions.explain: Ukrainian is most commonly written in the Cyrillic script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Tok Pisin?
questions.explain: Tok Pisin is most commonly written in the Latin script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Aymara?
questions.explain: Aymara is most commonly written in the Latin script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Romanian?
questions.explain: Romanian is most commonly written in the Latin script.
